meta.encoding: hex unless the field name says otherwise; *Base64/*B64 are standard base64 with padding

cases.name: a churned body
cases.pins: forty rewrites fold into one paragraph and the delete set

cases.name: roots this build does not type survive
cases.pins: markdownSource and a future root, never typed by the reader, are in the snapshot (§12.5.1)

cases.name: a server body under local churn
cases.pins: the snapshot holds the server items too; the server rows stay where they are

cases.name: a fold over an earlier fold
cases.pins: the earlier local snapshot counts among the bytes replaced

cases.name: a peer edit made before the fold
cases.pins: a paragraph typed against a body the later rewrites deleted merges into the snapshot as into the log

cases.name: refused: one update
cases.pins: a snapshot no smaller than the rows it replaces is not written

cases.name: refused: nothing local
cases.pins: server rows alone are the server namespace, which a local fold never takes

cases.name: refused: a local update waits on one the log lacks
cases.pins: an update held back for a missing antecedent is not in the encode, so nothing folds
